cases.sentence: ___ пас стада, а Каин обрабатывал землю.
cases.translation: Abel kept flocks, while Cain worked the ground.
cases.explain: Авель is the subject of пас (kept/tended), so it takes the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Кровь твоего брата взывает ко мне из ___.
cases.translation: Your brother's blood cries out to me from the ground.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of/from) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: Then the Lord said to Cain, 'Why are you angry?'
cases.explain: The verb сказать (to say/tell) takes the person addressed in the dative case.

cases.translation: Then she gave birth to his brother Abel.
cases.explain: Брата is the direct object of родила (gave birth to); animate masculine nouns take an accusative identical to the genitive.

cases.translation: Your brother's blood, shed by your hand.
cases.explain: The instrumental case here expresses the means or instrument — 'by your hand' — without needing a preposition.

cases.sentence: Когда они были в ___, Каин накинулся на своего брата Авеля и убил его.
cases.translation: When they were in the field, Cain attacked his brother Abel and killed him.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Авель пас стада, а Каин обрабатывал землю.
reading.question: What were the occupations of Cain and Abel?
options: Abel kept flocks and Cain worked the ground
Cain kept flocks and Abel worked the ground
reading.correct: Abel kept flocks and Cain worked the ground
reading.explain: The text says 'Авель пас стада, а Каин обрабатывал землю' — Abel kept flocks, and Cain worked the ground.

reading.ru: Каин разгневался, и лицо его потемнело от гнева.
reading.question: How did Cain react when his offering was not accepted?
options: He became angry and his face grew dark
reading.correct: He became angry and his face grew dark
reading.explain: The text says Cain 'разгневался, и лицо его потемнело от гнева' — became angry and his face darkened with anger.

reading.ru: Но если ты поступаешь неправильно, то у твоих дверей притаился грех».
reading.question: What did God warn Cain was lurking at his door?
reading.explain: God warns that 'у твоих дверей притаился грех' — sin is crouching at his door.

reading.ru: Каин накинулся на своего брата Авеля и убил его.
reading.question: What did Cain do to Abel in the field?
options: He argued with him and left
reading.explain: The text says Cain 'накинулся на своего брата Авеля и убил его' — attacked his brother Abel and killed him.

reading.ru: Теперь ты проклят, изгнан с земли, которая разверзлась, чтобы принять кровь твоего брата, пролитую твоей рукой.
reading.question: What curse did God pronounce on Cain?
options: He would be cursed and driven from the ground that received his brother's blood
reading.correct: He would be cursed and driven from the ground that received his brother's blood
reading.explain: God says Cain is 'проклят, изгнан с земли, которая разверзлась, чтобы принять кровь твоего брата' — cursed and driven from the ground that received his brother's blood.

reading.ru: И Господь сделал Каину метку, чтобы никто, встретившись с ним, не убил его.
reading.question: Why did God give Cain a mark?
options: So that no one who found him would kill him
To identify him as a sinner
reading.correct: So that no one who found him would kill him
reading.explain: The text says God made a mark 'чтобы никто, встретившись с ним, не убил его' — so that no one who met him would kill him.

reading.ru: В то время люди начали призывать имя Господа.
reading.question: What did people begin to do in the days of Enosh?
options: Call on the name of the Lord
reading.correct: Call on the name of the Lord
reading.explain: The chapter ends, 'В то время люди начали призывать имя Господа' — at that time people began to call on the name of the Lord.
